text:
Assistant B provides a more comprehensive, accurate, and detailed overview of Japanese business etiquette. It covers additional important aspects such as dress code, decision-making processes, non-verbal communication, and socializing, and offers specific, culturally nuanced guidance (e.g., proper handling of business cards, appropriate bow depth, use of honorifics, gift-giving customs). Assistant A contains some inaccuracies (e.g., handshake as standard greeting, advice to avoid slurping) and lacks depth on several key norms.
